sourceAttempts.method: Deerfield Dryway and #2 Dam Section reach pages
sourceAttempts.result: Documents the 2.5-mile Monroe Bridge-to-Dunbar Dryway, its Class III–IV release-dependent character, and the eight-mile Class I–II Wilcox Hollow-to-Stillwater reach with public endpoint names and a mandatory No. 2 Station portage.

sourceAttempts.family: American Whitewater release and gauge correlations
sourceAttempts.method: Dryway release agreement and Wilcox/Stillwater live flow correlation
sourceAttempts.result: Publishes 900–1,100 cfs scheduled Dryway releases and a 400 cfs low-runnable / 20,000 cfs end-high-runnable correlation for USGS 01170000 on the lower reach.

Direct Deerfield telemetry is retained for both routes; the downstream Charlemont station is a timing/trend reference for the Dryway, while 01170000 is the direct gauge named for Wilcox-to-Stillwater.
Generated canonical geometry assets for both reaches and retained the documented public water-entry endpoints.

dryway.reachApplicability: Scheduled Monroe Bridge whitewater release; Class IV reach remains planning-only under the catalog publication gate.

wilcoxStillwater.reachApplicability: American Whitewater #2 Dam Section, Wilcox Hollow to Stillwater Bridge; verify local wood, bridge and dam conditions.

putIn.name: Deerfield Station No. 5 / Monroe Bridge launch

endpointEvidence.note: Endpoints are water-entry-edge anchors from American Whitewater’s documented access chain; the lower reach preserves an intermediate No. 2 Station land-portage boundary.

safetyAndCamping.posture: Day-use routes. Do not camp at utility facilities, access points, portage areas or private banks; use separately permitted lodging or campgrounds.
